test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the grammatically correct sentence from the given options.

options.text: The Nile is the longest river in the world with a length about approximately 6650 km.
The Nile is the long river in the world with a length about approximately 6650 km.
The Nile is the most long river in the world of a length of approximately 6650 km.
The Nile is the longest river in the world with a length of approximately 6650 km.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. The Nile is the longest river in the world with a length of approximately 6650 km.

• The sentence in option 4 is grammatically correct and conveys the intended meaning clearly.</l
